existing_proofs_preserved: The entire inner token loop and vocabulary-range branch are represented, including signed int32 token IDs, separate context/load/store masks, out-of-vocabulary zero fill, tail fallback token conversion, finite flat execution and full off-write frame. The candidate only commutes a natural index product; no arithmetic rewrite assumptions are needed.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Complete per-program token loop with valid/out-of-vocabulary and tail behavior is covered.
Fixed N64/NN1, next-power-of-two hidden block, shape/stride wiring and whole context grid are uncomposed.

dtype_review: Formal source fixes IDs=int32 and one shared fp32/fp16/bf16 weight/output storage. Python independently supplies IDs, weight and out, with no equality or int32 guard; int64 IDs, fp64 weights and mixed destinations require their actual admitted routes or explicit rejection cases.
branch_review: Below-start, in-range and >=end IDs are already handled; negative out-of-vocabulary IDs are not missing. Context-tail loads use the source fallback, including its int32 conversion in the formal Bounds. The wrapper grid is the missing composition, not the token loop or zero-fill branch.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper chooses BLOCK_N64,BLOCK_NN1 and next_power_of_2(hidden), then launches ceil(n_ctx/64) programs.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Public correct_target covers one program and its internal loop, without establishing all caller-provided out writes across this exact grid/stride configuration.

structural_gaps.finding: TypedSource fixes int32 IDs and identical three-choice weight/output storage despite independent original arguments.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: ID-width semantics and mixed data destination casts are missing source cases; lookup arithmetic or copy assumptions cannot establish those routes.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Same-format weight copy itself needs no invented arithmetic law. Mixed-format conversion rounding can be deferred only after the actual storage route is modeled; vocabulary predicates and ID addressing remain structural.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
